paragraphs: Gurya bar Chama. Rava would recite the blessing at the departure of the Sabbath over his light, which was near his house (Berakhot 53b). The mnemonic is: the son of this one bears the name of the father of that one. For this Gurya is the son of Chama, son of Gurya, and was named after his grandfather.
